target: superpopulation mean signed request delivery by randomized dose and prespecified event-x group
sample_usage: all 600 independent user clusters used for fixed estimator; no model selection or train/test split; 100 fresh Monte Carlo repetitions for evaluation

scm.user_u: independent user U(-1,1), shared across 14 events
scm.acceptance: V uniform(0,1) event, A=(V<p), retained including refusal
scm.Y: sum((3-Pobs)*10)/1800, signed unclipped; fixed request denominator
scm.future_check: analytic margin only: (.5+.75*(x+1))*(3600+1800*(x+1)-1800) - 1.5*A*c*(1200-delay) >=0; no full recovery waveform claim
scm.paired_variants: share exogenous quantities, doses and meter noise across four mechanisms

inference.point: observed group-dose ratio sums/counts, no shape restriction
inference.resample_unit: whole user; multinomial(600,[1/600]*600), preserve all events, event groups and doses; same weights across scenarios/groups
inference.band: gain=mean(d)-mean(0); max over six nonzero nodes abs(bootstrap_gain-gain); empirical .95 higher quantile q; gain+-q, baseline interval exactly [0,0]
inference.support_failure: original count<50 or any bootstrap group-dose denominator zero => affected cell unavailable, no dropped draws, no regeneration
inference.coverage: approximate 95% simultaneous over six gains, separately per scenario/group; no across-group/scenario joint claim
inference.first_candidate: k in 1..6 iff upper[k]>=delta and all lower[1:k]<delta
inference.crossing_definition: first grid gain>=delta; no crossing iff all grid gains<delta; nodes only, no continuous root or hard economic threshold

evaluation: persist observed-only gains/bands before evaluator-only analytic truth; mean c=.6*(13/15) overall, .5*(13/15) low, .7*(13/15) high; mean delay fraction .975, E user_u=0; gain=E[c]*.975*increment; independent polynomial quadrature check; all 100 repetitions in denominators, count unavailable separately, exact binomial MC intervals
scope: B1 synthetic EV only; no forest/DML rerun, no new dependencies/server/page, no real-data or acceptance claim; old experiments immutable
reuse: installed NumPy 2.2.6/SciPy 1.15.3 BSD primitives; generic scipy.stats.bootstrap does not itself implement this cluster simultaneous-band inversion
